intent: A mourning gothic-lolita court gown for the classic blocky body, in deep black with blood crimson and bone lace: from the high camera a bowed, clock-pinned headdress and short black veil sit on a narrow-shouldered, red-banded bodice over a tiered black bell skirt to the ankles.
reason: The best silhouette: a narrow laced bodice over an A-line that falls in tiers to the ankles, with a veiled bowed headdress, solemn and clearly a dress; first fix: almost all black from above, so give the skirt tiers a crimson or bone edge that reads at the ARPG camera.
